implementation_conventions: SYNTH source pretraining uses A2DFP/CDFP with NAC disabled because synthetic captions have no aligned clean NAC target; target finetuning initializes NAC explicitly.
SYNTH uses the complete released source annotations without further offline expansion by default; the paper does not specify source expansion. Target full experiments use dual expansion.
Table 5/8 supported ablations share a baseline-only SYNTH checkpoint; added modules initialize explicitly. The paper does not specify common initialization.
All compared training variants use the same identity sampler and K=4.
Unfiltered augmentation requires an independently prepared unfiltered manifest; a filtered manifest cannot stand in for that arm.
Source checkpoint selection uses the final fixed-schedule epoch; target selection uses official validation R1 when available, otherwise the final epoch.
Training settings shared across source and targets where the paper gives no separate source schedule; record this as a recovery convention.
SDM temperature 0.02 is inherited from the recovered baseline, not the ambiguous CDFP temperature mentioned in the paper.
unsupported_experiments: Table 9 random-mask / without-visual / without-repair NAC variants
Full/partial SYNTH pretraining scale comparison; requires explicit independently defined source subsets
